caption: The drawing depicts a metallic lantern with a cylindrical body and a conical top, rendered primarily in muted shades of brown and gray. The lantern stands vertically, with its arched door open to the right, revealing the interior and a holder containing a short, stick-like object that may represent a candle. The surface of both the body and the door displays an array of patterned perforations and stamped designs, arranged in horizontal and chevron-like rows. Attached to the pointed top of the lantern is a large, circular handle oriented upward, with an additional small looping detail where it meets the tip. The object is set against a plain beige background, bordered by two faintly outlined rectangular frames—one tighter around the lantern and another closer to the edges of the paper. The entire composition is presented in a realistic style with careful shading to indicate light and shadow, giving the lantern a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
